seo.title: What is structured data?
seo.description: Structured data is machine-readable markup added to a page that states what it is about in a vocabulary search engines understand.

definition: Structured data is machine-readable markup added to a page that states what it is about in a vocabulary search engines understand.
answerBlock: Structured data is machine-readable markup added to a page that states what it is about in a vocabulary search engines understand. It uses the schema.org vocabulary, usually written as JSON-LD in a script tag. It does not change what a visitor sees; it changes what a machine can be certain of.

body.heading: What does structured data do for a page?
paragraphs: It removes guesswork. A page can say that it is a service with a price range, an article with a publication date, a set of questions and answers, or a defined term inside a glossary. Search engines use that to build richer results, and assistants use it to decide what a page is.

It must describe what is actually on the page. Marking up a rating nobody left, or questions the page does not answer, is a policy violation as well as a lie, and the markup can be ignored or penalised.
The practical pattern is one node per thing: the organisation once for the site, a breadcrumb trail on every page, and the template's own type on top.

commercial.heading: Why does it matter commercially?
paragraphs: Rich results take more space in a search listing and carry more information before the click, which is worth more than a small ranking movement.
For answer engines it is corroboration: the page says the same thing twice, once for people and once for machines.

example.heading: What does it look like in practice?
example.body: Every page of this site carries an organisation node and a breadcrumb trail, service pages add a service with its price band, and each glossary entry is a defined term inside one defined term set.

service.title: AI search visibility
service.line: Technical SEO plus the newer work of being cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini and AI overviews.

terms.definition: Answer engine optimisation is the work of getting a company cited in the answers that AI assistants write, rather than only ranked in a list of blue links.
A canonical tag tells search engines which address is the official one for a page that can be reached at several addresses.
Core Web Vitals are three measurements Google publishes to describe how a page feels to the people using it: loading, responsiveness and visual stability.
llms.txt is a plain text file at the root of a website that describes the site and points to its most useful pages for AI assistants.
